      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import fasttext
import os
import time

print('Training with paper hyperparameters: dim=10, epoch=5, lr=0.1')
start = time.time()
model = fasttext.train_supervised(
    input='/app/work/full_train_lower.txt',
    dim=10,
    bucket=200000,
    wordNgrams=2,
    epoch=5,
    lr=0.1,
    minCount=2,
    thread=4,
    verbose=2
)
print(f'Training time: {time.time()-start:.1f}s')

model.save_model('/app/work/model_dim10.bin')
print(f'Model size: {os.path.getsize("/app/work/model_dim10.bin")/1024/1024:.2f} MB')

result = model.test('/app/work/test_lower.txt')
